# GetCiteFlow — GEO Platform

GetCiteFlow is a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) platform that helps websites get cited by AI search engines including ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. Scan. Diagnose. Fix.

## Core Features
- **AI Visibility Score** — 0-100 GEO score with breakdown across 6 dimensions
- **Missing Components Scan** — Detects missing FAQ Schema, llms.txt, robots.txt issues, weak entity clarity, missing AI-readable markdown
- **Actionable Recommendations** — Prioritized guidance on what to fix to improve AI visibility

## Services
- AI Visibility Growth: https://www.getciteflow.ai/services/ai-visibility-growth

## Pricing
Free: AI Visibility Score & GEO report for any URL — 6-dimension analysis, missing component detection
Enterprise Technical GEO: From $3,999 one-time — Full GEO optimization (site-wide audit, deployment support). Price varies by site size and scope.

Enterprise AI Visibility Growth: From $4,999/month — Managed service for brand presence across AI systems (industry-specific platform strategy, brand entity building, citation-optimized content, competitor citation gap analysis, cross-platform distribution, monthly monitoring & iteration). Custom-priced based on scope.
